Learn how credit rates work for ChatGPT Chat, Work, and Codex for Business & Enterprise/Edu plans.

OpenAI o3 will be retired from ChatGPT on August 26, 2026. Until its retirement, the o3 credit rate listed below continues to apply. This change does not affect API access. For more information, see: Model Release Notes .

This article outlines the current credit rates for ChatGPT Business and Enterprise/Edu plans under flexible, credit–based pricing. It covers ChatGPT models and features, ChatGPT for Excel, ChatGPT for PowerPoint, Workspace Agents, ChatGPT Work, and Codex.
For more information about how credits and flexible pricing work, see Flexible pricing for the Enterprise, Edu and Business plans .

If your Enterprise agreement specifies usage-based billing in U.S. dollars instead of credits, use the rate card identified in your agreement or contact your OpenAI representative. For Plus or Pro credit rates, see Using Credits for Flexible Usage in ChatGPT (Free/Go/Plus/Pro) .
How credit-based pricing works
A fixed number of credits per message, task, generation, or connected minute.
Credits per 1M input tokens, cached input tokens, and output tokens.
Tokens are small units of information that OpenAI models process and generate. For token-based credit rates, total credit usage is calculated as follows:
Total credits = (input tokens / 1,000,000 × input rate) + (cached input tokens / 1,000,000 × cached input rate) + (output tokens / 1,000,000 × output rate)
Actual credit usage varies based on the model, task complexity, input size, cached input, output length, automations, and fast mode. To learn more, see What are tokens and how to count them?
The credit rate for a ChatGPT message is based on the model used by the selected option.

Instant chat is unlimited. Medium, High, and Extra High use different reasoning efforts, but they all use GPT‑5.6 Sol and have the same rate of 10 credits per message. Selecting a higher reasoning effort does not increase the per-message credit rate. Pro uses GPT‑5.6 Sol Pro and is charged at 50 credits per message. Instant may automatically switch to Medium when a request requires more reasoning. When this happens, the message uses GPT‑5.6 Sol and is charged at 10 credits. Unlimited or virtually unlimited access is subject to abuse guardrails and any model-specific usage allowances. Temporary restrictions may apply to prevent misuse.

Codex referral promotions: ChatGPT Desktop Referral Promotions
Terms for ChatGPT Desktop referral offers
Promotion Overview

Eligible users may see an in-product ChatGPT Desktop referral offer. Depending on the offer, eligible users may be able to invite another person to try ChatGPT Desktop and receive a promotional benefit after the invited person completes the required action. Referral benefits may include usage credits, a rate-limit reset, temporary additional usage, or another benefit described in the offer. The exact benefit, eligible experience, cap, expiration, and redemption requirements may vary by plan, workspace, region, and promotion. Rewards are not granted when an invite is sent. They are granted only after the invited person accepts the invite, meets eligibility requirements, completes the qualifyi
Eligibility depends on the offer shown in-product. Receiving an invite or seeing an offer does not guarantee redemption. For workspace referrals, workspace eligibility may require:
Referral promotions have not been disabled by a workspace admin.
An eligible ChatGPT plan or workspace as described in the offer.
Prior ChatGPT Desktop activity or an eligible usage, credit, or rate-limit event described in the offer.
Remaining within any referral caps, cooldowns, or redemption limits described in the offer.
Accepting the referral through the official referral flow described in the offer.
Duplicate redemptions, self-invites, address aliases used to evade eligibility, device-linked self-referrals, and other suspected fraudulent or abusive activity are not eligible.

OpenAI's Service Credit Terms apply to any credits issued under a referral promotion. OpenAI's usage, rate-limit, and service terms also apply to any rate-limit reset, temporary usage benefit, or other promotional benefit issued under a referral promotion. Referral credits are not API credits unless the offer explicitly says otherwise. Referral benefits cannot be redeemed for cash and may not be transferred, sold, or exchanged. Rate-limit resets and temporary usage benefits apply only to the eligible experience described in the offer. Rate-limit resets are available only for ChatGPT Work or Codex, as described in the offer. These benefits do not create a cash, API, or transferable credit bal
How do ChatGPT Desktop referral promotions work?

Benefits vary by offer. They may include usage credits, a rate-limit reset, temporary additional usage, or another promotional benefit described in the offer. Rate-limit resets apply only to ChatGPT Work or Codex, as specified in the offer.
How do I activate a referral reward?

The invited person must accept the referral invite and complete the qualifying action described in the offer using ChatGPT Desktop. If the offer is tied to a ChatGPT Business workspace, the invited person may also need to join that workspace. Rewards are applied after those steps and any eligibility checks are complete.
Referral caps, cooldowns, and redemption limits vary by offer and are shown in the applicable offer. Some offers may limit the number of rewards per person, workspace, subscription, or time period.
Can existing ChatGPT Business workspaces participate in workspace-specific referrals?
Yes, if the workspace and users meet the offer's eligibility requirements, the workspace is in good standing, and referral promotions have not been disabled by a workspace admin.
What if the same person receives multiple referral invites?
Only the first qualifying referral invite can count toward reward redemption. Duplicate invites do not create additional rewards.
The reward may still be granted if the referral remains within any applicable redemption period and all other eligibility requirements are met.
Are referral credits API credits?
No, unless the offer explicitly says otherwise. Credits issued under these promotions are generally for the eligible experience described in the offer.
Are rate-limit resets credits?
No. Rate-limit resets and temporary usage windows are not credits and do not create a cash, API, or transferable credit balance.
Can workspace admins turn referral promotions off?

ChatGPT Business workspace admins may disable referral promotions for their workspace. If disabled, eligible users should not see workspace referral offers and new workspace referral rewards will not be granted.
Do referral rewards expire?

Referral rewards may expire as described in the referral offer or applicable terms. For offers that grant a banked rate-limit reset, the reset applies only to ChatGPT Work or Codex, as described in the offer, and must be used within 30 days after it is added to your bank, unless the offer says otherwise. Check the offer for expiration and redemption details.
Can OpenAI end or change these promotions?

OpenAI may modify or wind down referral promotions with at least 30 days' notice. OpenAI may also revoke or cancel rewards sooner in cases of suspected misuse, fraud, or other violations, in compliance with law, or as permitted under applicable terms.
Can I transfer or sell a referral offer?
No. Referral offers are intended only for eligible users and eligible invitees. They may not be transferred, sold, or exchanged.
Flexible usage credits: Using Credits for Flexible Usage in ChatGPT (Free/Go/Plus/Pro)
Key information and FAQs about using credits
Credits extend usage for supported features after included plan limits are reached. The supported feature set can change; the usage page and rate card show the options available to your plan.

We're adding the ability for you to purchase credits when you reach your plan's included limits, without the need to upgrade your plan. Credits currently can only be used with Codex (for Plus/Pro users only) and ChatGPT for Excel .
What changes for my plan
Nothing about your plan changes. You still get your plan's included usage.
Credits are a pay-as-you-go add-on for supported features when you need more usage beyond plan limits.
Flexible pricing availability varies by feature and plan. Check the usage page for what is available to your account.
How credits work

Your plan's included usage is used first. After you hit plan limits, usage draws from your credit balance. Read about Codex usage limits . For Plus and Pro, supported agentic features, including Codex, ChatGPT Work, and ChatGPT for Excel, can draw from the same agentic usage allowance. If you hit a usage limit in Codex on Plus or Pro, you'll see an option to add credits. You can also buy credits from Codex Settings > Usage > Credits on both web and the Codex app. Eligible Plus and Pro users can also turn on Auto top-up from Codex Settings > Usage . When your credit balance drops below your selected minimum balance, we automatically purchase only the amount needed to return it to your selecte

If a task starts while your balance is positive but finishes after concurrent usage depletes it, your balance can go negative. In that case, later credit purchases or auto top-ups may first offset the negative balance before increasing your available credits. Check Codex Settings > Usage Dashboard for your current balance and recent usage.
A typical ChatGPT for Excel/Sheets task using GPT-5.5 may consume between 5 and 20 credits per message.
A typical ChatGPT for PowerPoint task using GPT-5.5 may consume between 10 and 50 credits per message.
Can I use the same credits for different features?

Yes. Credits work across supported features available to your plan, which can include Codex, ChatGPT Work, and ChatGPT for Excel. For example, credits added through Codex can be used by other supported features on the same eligible account after included limits are reached.
Can I use auto top-up with credits?

Eligible Plus and Pro users can turn on auto top-up from Codex Settings > Usage Dashboard . When your credit balance drops below your selected minimum balance, we automatically purchase enough credits to return it to your selected target balance, up to any maximum monthly spend you set, using your default payment method on file. If your balance is already below the minimum when you turn it on, a purchase may happen right away.
Are credits refundable?
Credits are non-refundable, except where required by law. We may restore credits in cases of confirmed account compromise (see below).
Do credits expire or roll over?
Credits are valid for 12 months from purchase. Unused credits expire and do not roll over after the expiry date.
What happens if credits are used due to a compromised account?

If your account is compromised and credits are used without authorization, report the incident immediately using the Unauthorized Activity webform and contact OpenAI Support using the chat bubble in the bottom-right corner of this page . We will investigate the incident, restore lost credits if misuse is confirmed, and assist with password resets and security controls. We also recommend that you take immediate steps to secure the account by following the steps outlined here: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/7242626-how-can-i-report-fraud-or-suspicious-activity
Are credits transferable?
Credits are non-transferable, have no cash value, and cannot be resold or gifted.
What terms govern the purchase of credits?
Credits are subject to the above and the Service credit terms: https://openai.com/policies/service-credit-terms/

Usage limits by plan

If you’re nearing or have reached a Codex limit, open Settings or your usage dashboard . Check which allowance is exhausted, your credit balance, and any reset time shown. In an active Codex CLI session, enter /status.
For current limits, rates, and credit options, check the pricing page .

Codex, ChatGPT Work, ChatGPT for Excel, and Workspace Agents use a shared allowance and credit pool when those features are available on your plan. Usage depends on the model, where the task runs, task complexity, context, reasoning, speed, and tools. A long-running task can use substantially more than a short request.

Task work started through ChatGPT Voice in Work or Codex on desktop uses that same allowance. Connected Voice time is metered separately where flexible pricing applies. Regular Chat Voice has separate limits and doesn’t consume Codex usage.

Where supported, ChatGPT Desktop shows credit usage for individual Work and Codex chats. Regular Chat usage isn’t included. Estimated dollar values appear only when your workspace enables member cost visibility. They’re planning estimates, not invoices.

Members of eligible Enterprise workspaces with credit-based billing can open Settings > Usage & billing in ChatGPT Desktop. This shows their monthly Work and Codex allowance and recent credit history. Where available, they can also review locally available high-usage Work and Codex chats and each chat’s lifetime credit usage. See Reviewing Work and Codex usage and using Personal Analytics for navigation, data freshness, and setup.

Check the limit notice for the options available to your account. You may be able to add credits, use an available reset, upgrade, or wait until the displayed reset time. Eligible Plus and Pro users can buy credits without changing plans .

If purchased credits appear missing, first check that you’re in the correct account or workspace and review your recent usage. The credits guide also explains how a negative balance can affect a later purchase.

Contact OpenAI Support . Include the limit or credit balance you’re questioning, the reset time shown, a screenshot, the Codex client and model, and when it happened—including your time zone. Remove sensitive information from screenshots.
Do ChatGPT related rate limits for file upload limits, image limits and voice caps apply to Codex?

ChatGPT file uploads, image generation, or voice have separate usage limits, reset periods, and banners. For example, if you see banners like “50 images in the last day”, “resets in 720 hours”, reach voice caps, or see upload-limit banners while uploading files in ChatGPT, those limits do not apply to Codex. For details on image and video limits and voice limits, see image & video generation limits and voice usage limits . For information about ChatGPT file upload limits and troubleshooting, see File Uploads FAQ . For information on the status of various ChatGPT services, including file uploads, refer to the OpenAI status page .
How do Codex referral invitations and banked resets work?

Eligible users may see Codex referral invitations in the profile menu. Personal plan users may see Invite a friend , and eligible Business workspace members may see Invite a coworker . The invitation dialog shows details for the current offer, such as the current reward, invite limits, expiration, and any recipient requirements that apply.

For some Plus and Pro promotions, a successful referral can add a banked Codex rate-limit reset. To use a banked reset, open the profile menu and select the usage summary showing the available reset count, such as 1 reset available .
Referral rewards vary by offer and plan. For current reward, limit, and eligibility details, see Invite friends and coworkers and Codex Referral Promotions .
What happens if I reach a usage limit while Codex is working?

If you reach a usage limit during an active turn, Codex can continue working on that turn, subject to fair-use limits. After that turn, check the Codex usage page or the limit banner for the options available on your plan, such as adding credits, applying an available reset, upgrading, or waiting for the limit to reset. For more details, see Codex usage limits .
On August 31, 2026, GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini will no longer be available in Codex when you sign in with your ChatGPT account.
Can Support reset my usage limits?
No. OpenAI Support does not reset ChatGPT or Codex usage limits. If you reach a limit, wait until it resets or use another available option shown in your account.
How do one-time usage-limit resets work?

OpenAI may occasionally provide eligible users with a one-time reset of Codex or ChatGPT Work usage limits. Eligibility, the limits affected, and any redemption or expiration requirements may vary by offer. Future resets are not guaranteed.

An automatic reset is applied directly to the usage limits covered by the announcement. The automatic reset itself is not saved for later. Usage after it is applied counts toward your refreshed allowance. Some offers may also include a separate banked reset. If you receive one, check your account or the offer for redemption and expiration details.

We do not provide an additional reset, credit, refund, or other compensation solely because you were not eligible for a one-time reset, did not notice a correctly applied reset, or did not use a banked reset before its stated expiration.
